requirements.desc: REQ-1: test runner が 3 種別ラベル行を stdout に emit する
requirements.note: tests/run.js now prints `unit/integration/acceptance` label lines via `formatLabelSummary`, and missing categories are explicitly emitted as 0.

requirements.desc: REQ-2: flow.json test.summary に unit/integration/acceptance/exitCode が記録される
requirements.note: `exitCode` is always written, but default parser regex in `src/flow/lib/test-log-parser.js` is malformed, so labeled integration/acceptance counts are not reliably parsed and persisted.

requirements.desc: REQ-3: 組込 parser は 3 種別独立パース、欠損キーは書き込まない
requirements.note: Implementation intends independent parsing and omit-missing behavior, but the labeled-count regex is broken (`..., "im` inside pattern), so required parsing behavior is not correctly achieved.

requirements.desc: REQ-4: 既存 TAP 出力・終了コード・既存テスト pass 状態を維持
requirements.note: Exit-code propagation is preserved, but runner execution strategy/output shape changed (per-category runs plus extra label block), so full non-regression of TAP/pass-state is not demonstrated by the diff alone.

requirements.desc: REQ-5: preset 独自 parser が提供されていれば優先、なければ組込 default
requirements.note: `loadTestParser` prefers `src/presets/<key>/test-parser.js` when present and falls back to builtin parser; `run-tests` now resolves parser through this loader.

requirements.desc: REQ-6: preset parser は検出できたキーのみ返す契約
requirements.note: Loader/consumer accept sparse parser results as-is, and tests cover 3-key/2-key/empty-object custom parser cases without fabricating missing keys.

unplanned.change: Added top-level `test` npm script (`node tests/run.js`), which is not explicitly required in REQ-1..REQ-6.
Added QA template/documentation file unrelated to runtime requirement fulfillment.
Added review record document not covered by functional requirements.
Added process/gate log artifacts outside the specified feature behavior requirements.

summary.notes: Feature direction is mostly implemented (label emission and preset-parser override), but a parser regex defect prevents reliable satisfaction of the core summary-recording requirements; overall status is incomplete until that parsing bug is fixed and regression expectations are re-validated.
